name: Bored
desc: Has a 10% chance per turn to not do anything while inflicted.

name: Rooted
desc: Cannot use melee actions or swap out. Earth attacks on it free it.

name: Burned
desc: Takes 5% dmg per turn. Also lowers MATK by 15% while inflicted.

name: Wet
desc: Takes 125% damage from Electric attacks, 80% from Fire attacks, and has a 20% higher chance to get Frozen.

name: Frozen
desc: Cannot use ranged actions or swap out. Fire attacks on it free it.

name: Nauseus
desc: Has a 10% chance per turn to use the wrong action and lowers RATK by 10% while inflicted.

name: Afraid
desc: The second half of all attacking actions an opponent uses loses 30% Accuracy.

name: Exposed
desc: Opposing attacks that have >79% accuracy are unable to miss while inflicted.

name: Dizzy
desc: Attacks have a 20% chance to self-harm.

name: Burrowed
desc: Immune to ranged attacks but cannot use ranged.

name: Prone
desc: If a Prone Mon's attack is blocked, canceled, or misses, the next attack that successfully hits it deals increased damage.

name: Groovy
desc: Repeated attacks do extra damage increasingly.
